method.name: PACTA
method.rename_reason: The CAST acronym collided with prior counterfactual-action work; the scientific object was not changed.
method.adaptation_gap: Current-state relevance does not establish feedback-specific behavioral authority.
method.mechanism: Use same-trajectory outcome-flipped success/failure writer twins as factual and shadow references; project both into the current action schema under two frozen renderings; grant the factual branch additional structured transport only when both branches are stable and action-contrasting.

novelty_audit.claim_boundary: Novelty is limited to paired same-trajectory outcome-flipped writer twins, current-state action projection, cross-rendering stability, action contrast, and factual-only additional transport authority.

pilot.early_stop_reason: The frozen projection-failure and gate-geometry conditions were already irreversibly failed; further policy calls could not change the Pilot verdict.

U.reason: Complete policy geometry was not consumed after irreversible pre-policy gate failure; partial responses have no scientific U authority.

failure_differential.strongest_competing_explanation: The ACTION SCHEMA field carried the full native browser system instruction, including a stronger native response envelope; the projector followed that nested contract and emitted current_state plus action rather than action plus next_goal.

reopen_conditions: Do not edit or resume this frozen study.
Any future attempt must be a separately frozen method revision.
Qualify action-schema extraction on non-scientific fixtures before any scientific state.
Use a new prospective sample, not the six observed Pilot states or the thirteen states sealed for this failed design.
